items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: It's really true that Shulky played just like Renee, kid Renee.

ctx.x: That's right. Shulky did. And Shulky picked up Renee's style.

But I never heard, he never played such high notes actually. No but he just, he played, Renee was a little higher but the same style that Shulky had, Renee had that same style. When you hear Shulky you hear Renee. It's really true. It's really true that Shulky played just like Renee, kid Renee. I think they, I don't know if Renee taught him or what but I know every time Renee would play his job Shulky would be around.

I think somebody did say he almost took lessons, at least they used to follow the band around. That's right. Shulky did. I think somebody said he maybe even took a couple of lessons or something from him.
